stories.title: President Trump says U.S. 'must' respond to Iran attack that downed Army helicopter
stories.summary: Monday night, President Trump spoke optimistically about negotiations to end the war with Iran. Now, he has confirmed that Iran shot down a U.S. Army Apache helicopter, saying the U.S. must respond.

stories.title: Nollywood's new screen: Nigerian filmmakers skip cinemas for YouTube
stories.summary: In Nigeria, a film revolution is unfolding — not in cinemas, but on YouTube.

stories.title: San Francisco immigration court shuts down, striking at heart of historic advocacy
stories.summary: San Francisco was the gateway to the U.S. for millions of immigrants. The closure of its immigration court affects hundreds of thousands of immigration cases and deals a symbolic blow to advocates.

stories.title: From side gigs to canceling trips, Americans adjust to months of high gas prices
stories.summary: Months of higher gas prices are taking a toll. We check in on the trade-offs people are making.

stories.title: Fuming in N.J.: As World Cup costs add up, some question whether hosting is worth it
stories.summary: With only days to go before the World Cup, some people in New Jersey are fuming about how much the tournament is going to cost the state — and making their feelings known.

stories.title: Meet Astronaut Andre Douglas — ready to bring more moon joy — on Artemis III
stories.summary: NASA announced the Artemis III crew on Tuesday. NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Andre Douglas who will serve as a mission specialist.
